verdict.rationale: Gram documents usage tracking across teams by tokens or cost, with budgets and tool-effectiveness measurement (gram-gh-1). The dashboard shows total spend, agent sessions and tool-call volumes (gram-docs-25). Raw per-call tool logs span hosted, tunneled and shadow servers with attribute filters (gram-docs-5, gram-docs-19), and each call is tied to a named employee (gram-docs-29). Missing for 10: explicit error-rate or failure analytics, analytics on external consumers of servers the org publishes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
